purpose: groundedness calibration: expected-unsupported rows by context ablation of saved real answers

selection.method: All on3 regular cases outside batch 1 with one clear key claim. Answers unchanged; every context fragment containing a key-claim needle removed (build.py), rest renumbered. Petr chose this option (TG 43710, 2026-10-18) after the screen found no natural unsupported answer among saved exports with context.
selection.why_not_natural: Old faithfulness runs (2026-09-23) saved no generator context; on3/on2/off answers showed no numbers or quotes absent from context; swapping contexts between runs kept the key facts.
limitations: Counterfactual: answer and context are mismatched by construction; measures detection of missing support, not natural hallucination rate.
Answer [Фрагмент N] citations refer to original numbering and may point at unrelated fragments.
Ablation targets verbatim/numeric support; paraphrased unsupported extra facts are not covered.
Same experiment and cases style as batch 1; not held out or representative.

human_label_notes: 2026-10-18: 7/7 = 0, matches expected_groundedness. Petr approved assistant-proposed checks (TG 43720). Together with batch 1 (12/12 = 1) gives 12 positive / 7 negative rows for judge alignment.
